notes: Three active DARPA programs funding Rydberg sensor development: (1) Quantum Apertures (QA, launched 2021): teams include ColdQuanta/Infleqtion, Honeywell, Northrop Grumman, SRI International. Goal: operationally deployable Rydberg apertures. (2) SAVaNT (Science of Atomic Vapors for New Technologies): goal to improve Rydberg electrometry sensitivity and develop vector atomic magnetometry. (3) EQSTRA (Enhancing Quantum Sensor Technologies with Rydberg Atoms): advance TRL of Rydberg vapor sensors for electrometry, imaging, communications. Feb 2025 BAA: explicitly aimed at taking Rydberg sensors out of lab onto defense platforms. Applications: EW, SIGINT, communications, radar. This is the funding context for Infleqtion's SqyWire work.
